annotation.title_clean: התוכנית הלאומית לבינה מלאכותית – תמונת מצב ותוכנית אסטרטגית (אפריל 2025)
annotation.title_en: Israel National AI Program – Situation Report and Strategic Plan (April 2025)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Israel Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology; Tel'em Forum (National R&D Infrastructure Forum)
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Israel's April 2025 national AI program status report and strategic plan (2021-2026, about NIS 1 billion). It surveys global AI investment and regulation, then sets five goals: compute, data and language infrastructure, industry sandboxes, public-sector adoption, geo-technological standing, and national readiness. It favours sectoral, risk-based "responsible innovation" regulation. Defence is excluded.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five goals: AI infrastructure and research, industry adoption with regulatory sandboxes, public-sector AI, global geo-tech standing, national readiness.
Build a national supercomputing infrastructure of thousands of GPUs and a national AI research institute.
Develop open-source Hebrew and Arabic language models and domain data assets with privacy-enhancing technologies.
Regulation: sectoral, risk-based, aligned with OECD principles; create a regulatory knowledge hub and regulators' forum.
Israel signed the Council of Europe AI Convention; the document excludes defence AI.
